entries.detail: NJCU completed a merger with Kean University on July 1, 2026, forming 'Kean Jersey City'. Per official Kean/NJCU merger announcements and D3sports coverage, ALL NCAA Division III sports on the NJCU (Jersey City) campus are eliminated at the end of the 2025-26 academic year. Kean Jersey City competes in the USCAA and sponsors ONLY women's soccer and men's basketball beginning 2026-27 — men's soccer is NOT continued. Former NJCU men's soccer players must try out to join Kean's NCAA teams. Therefore the NCAA D3 men's-soccer programme (unitid 185129, NJAC) no longer operates as of fall 2026. Last head coach Brendan Guzman (2023-2025, email [withheld]@njcu.edu) left in April 2026 to become head men's soccer coach at Centenary University. Domain evidence: njcugothicknights.com now redirects to keanathletics.com and njcu.edu to kean.edu/jersey-city.
